isolation.database: unique disposable PostgreSQL database created by the test harness
isolation.cleanup: database is dropped during guaranteed fixture teardown
isolation.developerData: never read, migrated, truncated, or modified

identities.note: Passwords and session tokens are generated or supplied only by the test harness and are not fixture data.

cases.purpose: Create, validate, compose, compare, publish, and reload a dynamic invoice schema containing direct fields and immutable modules.
assertions: server assigns the created draft identity
module versions and dynamic fields survive publication
published version remains immutable after the draft advances

cases.purpose: Prove invalid dynamic content is rejected before persistence.

acceptanceCriteria.create: apply the valid package as a new server-owned draft
acceptanceCriteria.validate: preview both valid and invalid packages
acceptanceCriteria.compare: preview the valid package against an existing draft and inspect compatibility
acceptanceCriteria.publish: publish the created draft and retrieve its immutable version
acceptanceCriteria.compose: retain and publish both embedded immutable module versions
